commits.message:
fix(render)!: colour depth governs SGR only — hyperlinks are their own fact

segmentsToString/segmentToString take a required `hyperlinks` argument;
renderToString gains a `hyperlinks` option (default true). A null colour
system (NO_COLOR, colour depth none) no longer strips OSC 8 links. Console
and Live emit links exactly when the destination is a terminal, so piped
output stays plain.

feat(strip)!: powerline caps are values — a lead opens a coloured run, a tail closes it (#158)

* feat(strip)!: powerline caps are values — a lead opens a coloured run, a tail closes it

PowerlineJoinerOptions gains lead and tail beside glyph and divider. A join is
painted in whichever neighbour has a background: both, the arrow; left only, the
tail; right only, the lead; neither, nothing. The default set leads with U+E0B2
and tails with U+E0B0, so a strip's two ends are one shape; "" draws an end flat.

BREAKING CHANGE: PowerlineJoinerOptions requires lead and tail, and the default
joiner now draws a start cap.

* fix(strip): a flat cap draws no segment; caps and arrows share one drawn-ground helper

- cap("", …) yields nothing, the same output as a join with nothing to paint
- drawnGround hoisted beside paintableBg instead of rebuilt per join
- tests pin the default tail and the lead/tail on every wrapped FlexStrip line
- docs and the strip demo describe the four-glyph set; package-lock at 0.16.0
